card.text: Explore Puck with Voyager 2 imagery on its measured-size shape.

introduction.text: Puck is the largest of Uranus’s small inner moons. Voyager 2 photographed its dark, cratered surface in 1986; most of this little world remains unseen.

normal.title: Image C2683716
normal.summary: Each source pixel spans about 4.77 km, too coarse for fine terrain. The gray grid marks unseen or unreliable areas.
